references.observed: Bureau of Reclamation front aerial shows the curved crest, three drum gates, two tall flanking towers, the central chute, five exposed penstocks and the powerhouse on the downstream bank.
Aerial view shows the abutments, the sloped pressure pipe routes and the independent access road bridge. Water and switchyard remain separate from the dam asset.
Owner lists a 3,460 foot crest, 1,077.5 foot crest elevation, 602 foot structural height and 30 foot crest width.
The curved native crest road and named Shasta Powerplant locate the dam. Shasta Lake and the Sacramento River establish the downstream direction.
